text: The ‘Simple OneS’ is a game-changing electric vehicle that has been specifically designed and manufactured in India. With its sleek design and superior performance, the ‘Simple OneS’ is the perfect choice for anyone who wants to drive an affordable, yet high-quality EV. The Simple OneS comes in three different colour variations, including Brazen Black, & Grace White, allowing users to choose the one that suits their style. One of the key features of the Simple OneS is its advanced electric motor, designed to perform optimally in the conditions of Indian roads. The Simple OneS is available with 3.7 kWh with a peak power

title: simple_ones_owners_manual
text: output of 6.4 kW. Powered by a robust and highly efficient lithium-ion battery, which has been engineered to deliver long-lasting performance, making it ideal for daily commutes and longer journeys. In addition to its impressive performance, the Simple OneS also features a CBS brake that has been designed to provide a sporty dynamic experience. This advanced brake system ensures that the vehicle can stop quickly and smoothly, even at high speeds, providing an added level of safety and peace of mind. simpleenergy.in 22

title: simple_ones_owners_manual
text: Another great feature of the Simple OneS is its spacious 35 L under-seat storage, which provides ample space for storing personal belongings. Whether you need to carry a laptop, a gym bag, or groceries, the ‘Simple OneS’ has you covered. Overall, the Simple OneS is an excellent choice for anyone who wants to drive a premium and sustainable electric vehicle that is built to last. text: 4.16. Traction Control Traction Control limits wheel slip during aggressive riding and low grip conditions. TC has 4 modes - RAIN, ROAD, TRACK and RALLY. • Rain mode is suitable for low traction surfaces. • Road mode is designed for everyday use. • Track mode maintains optimal traction for aggressive riding conditions. • Rally mode provides optimized traction over loose surfaces. 4.17. Super Hold Super Hold prevents rolling of the vehicle on inclined surfaces without the rider having to apply brakes continuously. Both forward and reverse rolling are controlled by Super Hold. To activate, bring the vehicle to a standstill on the inclined surface by applying

title: simple_ones_owners_manual

title: simple_ones_owners_manual
text: Maintenance Schedule Proper and regular maintenance is crucial for the optimal performance of the 'Simple OneS'. The following section outlines Simpleenergy's recommended schedule for inspecting, checking, replacing, adjusting, lubricating and servicing the vehicle. Neglecting this schedule may cause accelerated wear and severe damage to the vehicle, leading to a reduced lifespan. If the vehicle is exposed to high levels of stress, such as continuous full throttle or driving in a dusty environment, some maintenance tasks may need to be performed more frequently than the recommended schedule. This is necessary to ensure the vehicle's reliability. Key components such as steering, suspension, and

title: simple_ones_owners_manual
text: wheels require special care and attention. The recommended maintenance schedule is mandatory and should only be carried out by Simpleenergy's authorised team. Regular inspections may reveal the need for replacement of one or more parts. It is highly recommended to replace scooter parts with original Simpleenergy parts for smooth warranty coverage and vehicle durability. Appropriate maintenance is required to ensure that the vehicle is reliable and provides optimal performance at all times. simpleenergy.in 88

text: Maintenance Schedule - To protect the 'Simple OneS' scooter from long-term damage due to exposure, it is important to wash it regularly. - Metal parts cleaning : Use Isopropyl alcohol (IPA) or hydrocarbon-based cleaners (low aromatic) - Heavy grease removal : Use Diesel or kerosene (with caution & proper ventilation) - Plastic & painted parts : Use Mild shampoo or automotive surface cleaner - Prior to washing, use a low-pressure water spray to remove any dirt that may scratch the paint. - Use one sponge to wash the body and a separate one to clean the wheels and

title: simple_ones_owners_manual
text: tyres. - After washing with a cleaning solution, rinse the scooter again with a low-pressure water spray. - Avoid using high-pressure or steam jet cleaners as they can damage the paint or components of the scooter. Instead, use a water or two-wheeler washing solution. - Do not use hand soaps, dish-washing liquids, or glass cleaner fluids. simpleenergy.in 92
